segments.text: Years ago, Thom, a young man who dreamed of space, broke up with Celia, a robotics engineer with a robot hand. Celia ended it with: we're done.
In the present, an armed team launches a mission with a window of about ten minutes.
Their plan is to re-stage the old breakup like a film take, with Thom repeating his lines while a machine overwrites a memory.
Celia is the threat they are fighting. She tells Thom he broke her heart and forgot her on Earth, and threatens to crush him.
Thom drops the script and simply apologizes.
As the battle peaks, he tells her the world has changed and maybe they can too. The memory overwrite completes.
